description: This file contains utility functions and classes for testing pandas and pandas-on-Spark DataFrames and Series within the PySpark framework. It includes assertion methods, comparison utilities, and context managers for warnings, specifically tailored for testing pandas compatibility and behavior in Spark environments.

classes.name: PandasOnSparkTestUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for pandas DataFrame/Series comparison, sorting, and conversion within tests.

classes.name: PandasOnSparkTestCase
classes.description: Base test case class integrating Spark configuration setup and teardown with pandas-on-Spark testing utilities.

classes.name: TestUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing context managers for temporary directories and files during tests.

classes.name: ComparisonTestBase
classes.description: Test base class combining pandas-on-Spark and pandas DataFrame/Series comparison utilities.

methods.name: _assert_pandas_equal
methods.description: Asserts that two pandas objects (DataFrame, Series, Index) are equal based on strict criteria.

methods.name: _assert_pandas_almost_equal
methods.description: Asserts that two pandas objects are approximately equal within tolerances.

methods.name: convert_str_to_lambda
methods.description: Converts a string representing a method name into a lambda function that calls that method.

methods.name: sort_index_with_values
methods.description: Sorts pandas or pandas-on-Spark DataFrame/Series by index and values.

methods.name: assertPandasEqual
methods.description: Wrapper method to assert pandas objects are equal.

methods.name: assertPandasAlmostEqual
methods.description: Wrapper method to assert pandas objects are approximately equal.

methods.name: assert_eq
methods.description: General assertion method for comparing two objects, with options for approximate equality and row order ignoring.

methods.name: _to_pandas
methods.description: Converts pandas-on-Spark objects to pandas DataFrame/Series/Index.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Sets Spark configuration for arrow optimization before tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Checks Spark SQL ANSI mode configuration before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Verifies Spark SQL ANSI mode configuration after each test.

methods.name: temp_dir
methods.description: Context manager for creating and cleaning up a temporary directory.

methods.name: temp_file
methods.description: Context manager for creating and cleaning up a temporary file.

methods.name: compare_both
methods.description: Decorator for comparing results of a test function between pandas and pandas-on-Spark DataFrames.
